subtopics.title: Perfect Markets: Equilibrium, Profit and the Shutdown Point

questions.question: The individual business in perfect competition is a price taker, so its demand curve is:
options: A horizontal line at the market price, where D = P = AR = MR

questions.question: A perfect competitor earns normal profit when:
options: Price is above average cost at equilibrium
Price just equals average cost at its lowest point — earning no more than resources could earn elsewhere
Price falls below average variable cost

questions.question: A loss-making business should shut down in the short run only when:
options: It makes any loss at all
Price is below average TOTAL cost
Price falls below average VARIABLE cost, so each unit produced deepens the loss

questions.question: The body that INVESTIGATES anti-competitive conduct in South Africa is:

subtopics.title: Imperfect Markets: Monopoly, Oligopoly and Monopolistic Competition

questions.question: For a monopolist, marginal revenue lies below the demand curve because:
options: Selling one more unit requires lowering the price on all units

questions.question: In the kinked demand curve story, demand is elastic ABOVE the current price because:
options: Rivals always match a price increase
A lone price-riser loses customers to rivals who hold their prices still

questions.question: Tacit collusion through price leadership means:
options: Firms follow the dominant firm's price changes without any formal agreement

questions.question: Hair salons and restaurants typify monopolistic competition because they combine:
options: Many sellers, easy entry and DIFFERENTIATED products

subtopics.title: Market Failures, State Intervention and Cost-Benefit Analysis

questions.question: With a negative externality such as pollution, the free market produces:
options: Too much at too low a price, because supply reflects only private cost
Too little at too high a price

questions.question: Street lighting is a public good because it is:
options: Non-rivalrous and non-excludable, so free riding defeats private supply

questions.question: A maximum price set below equilibrium causes:
options: A shortage — quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied — with queues and black markets

questions.question: A cost-benefit analysis recommends a project when:
options: Total social benefits exceed total social costs over the project's life

subtopics.title: Contemporary Issues: Inflation, Tourism and Environmental Sustainability

questions.question: The CPI moves from 120,0 to 127,2. The inflation rate is:
options: 6,0 percent — 7,2 divided by the OLD index of 120, times 100

questions.question: A weaker rand raising the cost of imported oil is a cause of:
Tourism absorbs job seekers quickly because it is:
Marketable pollution permits work by:
options: Capping total pollution and letting firms trade the right to emit within the cap

subtopics.title: The Spaza and the Giant: Market Structures Made Plain

questions.question: The tomato stalls at the taxi rank stand for perfect competition because:
options: Many sellers offer the same product and no stall can charge above the going price
One stall owns all the tomatoes
Each stall brands its tomatoes differently
The stalls watch and match each other like a cartel

questions.question: Good tomato profits attract new stalls by Friday, and profits melt back to normal. This illustrates:
options: Free entry competing economic profit away in the long run

questions.question: The banks and cell networks watching each other's prices like taxi associations on one route illustrates:
options: Oligopoly interdependence — no firm moves without weighing rivals' reactions

subtopics.title: When the Market Drops the Ball

questions.question: The scrapyard's smoke drifting over the school shows that:
options: The market price of burning ignores the cost dumped on others, so there is too much burning
The market always prices pollution correctly

questions.question: Left alone, the town buys too little education because:
options: Families weigh only their own benefit, while much of education's benefit leaks to everyone else

questions.question: A minimum wage set above the going rate tends to create:
options: A surplus of labour — some workers gain better pay while others are not hired

questions.question: The correct pairing of failure and fix is:
options: Smoke taxed, schooling subsidised, streetlight built by the municipality

subtopics.title: Prices, Tourists and the Planet in One Sweep

questions.question: Stalls marking up on grant day when everyone is spending illustrates:
options: Demand-pull inflation — prices pulled from the till side

questions.question: The repo rate fights cost-push inflation badly because:
options: Higher interest rates cannot make diesel or electricity cheaper — they only squeeze spenders
The repo rate only affects exporters

questions.question: Tourism is called an export that never leaves home because:
options: Foreign visitors spend foreign money inside South Africa
It is not counted in GDP

questions.question: The plastic bag levy is an example of:
options: Making the polluter pay through an environmental tax
